entries.purpose: Validate canonical foundation documents, integration pins and repository contracts.
triggers: every pull request
push to main
entries.fixture_strategy: No product fixture; deterministic Git tree and repository-document checks.
entries.isolation: Read-only repository inspection; no Docker, submodule download or external API call.
entries.cleanup: No runtime resources are created.
entries.evidence: GitHub Actions / Foundation Fast Gate
